description: Not available in this build: refuses before any request (it needs an independent chain proof that the no-op executed, which this client does not have). Release a stuck Safe nonce in the Felix app (Wallet) instead. Release this account's Arc home Safe nonce that an earlier Felix operation reserved but never executed (an expired, cancelled or observe-only HyperCore or Polymarket funding, or a same-chain Arc withdrawal). While such a nonce is reserved, every later Felix Safe move is refused. The owner signs ONE no-op Safe transaction (a call to the owner's own address, value 0, no data) at that nonce: it moves no funds, and once it executes the original can never execute. Before signing, the client rebuilds the no-op itself, checks it is for this account's Safe at the original's nonce, and proves the Safe's current nonce on its own private Arc quorum (FELIX_ARC_PROOF_RPC_URLS). Completion requires the engine's proof, this client's own proof that exactly this no-op executed, and Felix closing the original operation. If the original executed first, nothing is closed; resume the original instead. Use the exact original_writer and original_operation_id from the next_action of the tool that reported the reserved nonce. Felix keeps ONE invalidation per Safe nonce: when one already exists (next_action complete_invalidation), pass its invalidation_id to complete it instead of preparing a new one. Never use this tool while the blocking operation's next_action is reconcile_blocking_operation: its Safe transaction may still execute. Reuse the same idempotency_key after a timeout; nothing is signed twice.

expected_safe_nonce.description: Optional: the original's Safe nonce, when the reporting tool named it. The no-op must be at exactly this nonce.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it to resume this exact invalidation.

invalidation_id.description: Optional: an invalidation Felix already holds for this nonce (next_action complete_invalidation names it). It is completed instead of preparing a new one.

original_operation_id.description: The original operation or funding id (UUID).

original_writer.description: The Felix writer that reserved the nonce: withdrawal_source (a same-chain Arc withdrawal), hypercore (fund_hypercore_from_arc) or polygon (fund_polymarket_from_arc).

name: invalidate_safe_nonce
